name: iPSC tri-culture to capsule-based single-cell RNA library
description: Generated by autochip from 'iPSC tri-culture to capsule-based single-cell RNA library'. Four chips. Chip 1 is the 37 C culture and cell-prep chip. Chip 2 makes the capsules, which brings oil, and cures them. Chip 3 sits on the thermocycler for lysis, RT, index PCR and release. Chip 4 sits over the magnet for bead clean-up. Culture is kept apart from oil. Curing needs the 405 nm LED, the thermal steps need the thermocycler and the clean-up needs the magnet, so the equipment never has to be shared on one chip. All capsule traps use a 10 um mesh, below 0.4 x the 28 um capsule diameter, so capsules cannot slip through. Counting and fluorometer QC are done on the bench. Because the four portions carry different indexes, they are pooled after release and before bead clean-up, so step 24 is carried by the pool part on chip 3.

modules.name: Tri-culture, dissociation, quench, cell wash and filter chip
modules.note: Grows three iPSC-derived populations in separate chambers (apart, then sharing medium through the central junction), detaches them, quenches the enzyme, moves the cells into clean buffer and filters out clumps.

modules.name: Encapsulation, emulsion break, capsule wash and curing chip
modules.note: Merges cells into core solution, makes single-cell shell/core droplets in fluorinated oil, then breaks the emulsion, washes, cures and washes the capsules in a trap.

modules.name: Lysis, RT, split, index PCR, pool and release chip
modules.note: Lyses cells in capsules, reverse transcribes, splits into four portions for index PCR, pools them and releases the cDNA.

modules.name: Bead binding, ethanol wash and elution chip
modules.note: Binds cDNA to magnetic beads, washes on the magnet and elutes the library.

handoffs.note: filtered single cells (cell count checked on the bench) by off chip step, through bench step(s) 8

roadmap.name: Bench: step 25
roadmap.note: Measure library concentration and fragment size.
